text: 中共中央政治局常委、国务院副总理、中国环境与发展国际合作委员会主席丁薛祥在北京出席国合会2026年年会并讲话。
text_en: Ding Xuexiang, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, Vice Premier of the State Council, and Chairman of the China Council for International Cooperation on Environment and Development, attended the 2026 annual meeting of the council in Beijing and delivered a speech.
